title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: admin-approved branded footer on the Chat screen
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft Learn supports the admin paths, opt-in default, logo requirements and tenant-wide scope. The roadmap facts match the supplied record, and independent searches found no documented automation for either control.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Admins can display the organisation's logo at the bottom of the Chat screen in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.
claims.quote: You can display your organization's logo and an optional label at the bottom of the Chat screen in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The footer's label is optional.
claims.quote: You can display your organization's logo and an optional label at the bottom of the Chat screen in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Learn says the footer helps users identify their organisation's trusted, work-managed Copilot experience.
claims.quote: The branded footer helps users identify their organization's trusted, work-managed Copilot experience.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The footer reuses the logo configured on the Logos page of the organisation's default theme.
claims.quote: It uses the logo configured on the Logos page for your organization's default theme.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls
claims.claim: Other theme settings do not apply to the branded footer.
claims.quote: Other theme settings don't apply to the footer.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk; changes[0]
claims.claim: The footer is turned off by default.
claims.quote: The footer is turned off by default.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The default state is admin-opt-in: nothing changes until an administrator enables the footer.
claims.quote: The footer is turned off by default. ... Only global admins can customize company themes. ... Select Add your brand to Copilot Chat footer area.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Footer style offers No label, Approved by, Provided by and Managed by.
claims.quote: In the Footer styledropdown, select one of the following options: No label Approved by Provided by Managed by

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: No label displays the logo without a label.
claims.quote: You can display your organization's logo and an optional label ... In the Footer styledropdown, select one of the following options: No label

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Governance controls
claims.claim: The branded footer is available only for the default theme.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat | Add your organization's logo and an optional label to the footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. This option is available for the default theme only.

claims.where: controls[].scope; What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The enabled footer applies tenant-wide to all users of the Chat screen.
claims.quote: The branded footer uses your organization's default theme and applies to all users.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The footer cannot currently target different logos to specific user groups.
claims.quote: You can't currently target different logos to specific user groups.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Only global admins can customise company themes, including enabling this footer.
claims.quote: Only global admins can customize company themes.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope
claims.claim: Global readers have read-only access to company themes.
claims.quote: Global readers have read-only access.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org Settings > Organization profile > Custom themes > Default Theme > Copilot Chat > Add your brand to Copilot Chat footer area > Footer style reaches the footer control.
claims.quote: Settings > Org Settings ... Organization profile ... Custom themes ... Select your Default Theme. ... Open the Copilot Chat page. ... Select Add your brand to Copilot Chat footer area. ... In the Footer styledropdown

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented PowerShell, Graph or another API for enabling the branded footer or selecting its label.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 organization custom themes Copilot Chat branded footer PowerShell Graph API enable Footer style. Read theme page and Graph organizationalBranding; search also returned SharePoint site theming, which governs sites rather than this footer.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org Settings > Organization profile > Custom themes > Default Theme > Logos > Default logo reaches the theme logo setting.
claims.quote: Settings > Org Settings ... Organization profile ... Custom themes ... select Default Theme ... On the Logos page, you can add your logos ... Default logo: Add a URL location that points to your logo.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for setting this Microsoft 365 organisation theme logo.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 admin center organization default theme logo PowerShell API automation Set theme logo. Read theme and organizationalBranding pages; Graph header-logo and Power Apps theme search excerpts describe sign-in or model-driven apps, not this logo.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The default theme's logo setting also supplies the organisation theme's navigation bar logo.
claims.quote: Any theme appears in the top navigation bar for everyone in the organization as part of the Microsoft 365 suite header. If you enable the branded Copilot Chat footer for the default theme, its logo and selected label also appear at the bottom of the Chat screen

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A logo configured by URL must use HTTPS.
claims.quote: Default logo: Add a URL location that points to your logo. Make sure that the URL uses HTTPS.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A logo configured by URL must allow anonymous access without authentication.
claims.quote: Add an HTTPS image url that allows anonymous access and doesn't require authentication.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: An image hosted for a theme logo URL is publicly retrievable.
claims.quote: Make sure the logo you're using is specified as a publicly addressable URL. ... Add an HTTPS image url that allows anonymous access and doesn't require authentication.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The default theme also permits uploading a logo image smaller than 10kb.
claims.quote: For default theme, you also have an option to upload a logo image that is less than 10kb.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model
claims.claim: The footer is an included option inside Microsoft Copilot Chat under its eligible Microsoft 365 subscription requirement.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Chat is available to users with an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription. ... Microsoft Copilot license ... Not required for eligible users

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot Chat is available to users with an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Chat is available to users with an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A Microsoft Copilot licence is required for licensed Microsoft Copilot capabilities, not for eligible Copilot Chat users.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot license | Required for licensed Microsoft Copilot capabilities | Not required for eligible users

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The theme page names no licence specific to the branded footer.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot branded footer license price meter credit rate. Read the complete theme page and Copilot requirements; the former names no footer licence, while the latter gives Copilot Chat's general eligible-subscription requirement.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The theme page publishes no price, meter or credit rate for the footer.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot branded footer license price meter credit rate. Read complete theme page; no footer price, meter or rate. Search excerpts for Copilot billing rates and pay-as-you-go meters describe agents and responses, not this display setting.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Optional Azure Blob Storage logo hosting can incur storage and access costs.
claims.quote: This article helps you estimate the cost to store, upload, download, and work with data in Azure Blob Storage. ... When you transfer data, you pay for write and read operations.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The theme page suggests Azure Blob Storage or the Office 365 CDN as logo hosting options.
claims.quote: Follow these steps for uploading logos to Azure Blob Storage or the Office 365 Content Delivery Network with SharePoint Online.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Office 365 CDN service is included as part of a SharePoint Online subscription.
claims.quote: The Office 365 CDN service is included as part of your SharePoint Online subscription.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisite; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Learn instructs administrators to confirm the default theme's logo is configured on the Logos page before enabling the footer.
claims.quote: Select your Default Theme. ... On the Logos page, confirm that your organization's logo is configured. ... Open the Copilot Chat page. ... Select Add your brand to Copilot Chat footer area.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: There is no separately documented tenant switch for this footer apart from its Copilot Chat theme toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat branded footer tenant switch group targeting alternate dark logo platforms Mac mobile. Read complete theme page and search excerpts; only Add your brand to Copilot Chat footer area is documented for enabling this footer.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: At the time of writing, no PowerShell, Graph or other API for these Microsoft 365 organisation themes is documented in Learn.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 organization custom themes Copilot Chat branded footer PowerShell Graph API enable Footer style; Microsoft 365 admin center organization default theme logo PowerShell API automation Set theme logo. Read theme, Graph branding and search excerpts; no applicable API.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Graph organizationalBranding concerns Microsoft Entra sign-in branding, not the Microsoft 365 theme footer.
claims.quote: Organizations can customize their Microsoft Entra sign-in pages which appear when users sign in to their organization's tenant-specific apps, or when Microsoft Entra ID identifies the user's tenant from their username.

claims.where: Open questions: alternate logo
claims.claim: The organisation theme supports an alternate logo optimised for dark themes.
claims.quote: Alternate logo: Add a URL location that points to your logo. Your alternate logo should be optimized for use in Microsoft 365 dark themes.

claims.where: Open questions: alternate logo
claims.claim: Learn does not specify whether the footer selects the alternate dark-theme logo or only the default logo.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat branded footer tenant switch group targeting alternate dark logo platforms Mac mobile. Read complete theme page; it says the footer uses the logo on Logos, without specifying dark-mode selection. Search found no footer-specific clarification.

claims.where: Scope: Rollout; Open questions: mobile and Mac
claims.claim: Learn's footer description does not provide platform-by-platform behaviour for mobile, Mac or other clients.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat branded footer tenant switch group targeting alternate dark logo platforms Mac mobile. Read complete theme page; no client breakdown. Search returned platform-specific release notes for other features, not this footer.
